en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks were teaching the Dhamma to one who was lying down...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I shall not teach the Dhamma to one who is lying down and not ill.
The Dhamma is not to be taught to one who is lying down and not ill.

Whoever, out of disrespect, preaches the Dhamma even to one who is lying on the bare ground, reclining, and not ill, commits an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa). There is no offense if it is unintentional … [and so forth].
"For one who is a first offender":
thus ends the fourth training rule.
